Know who owns the information.

Open Path helps make a complicated journey easier to follow. Australian Government, state, and territory agencies own their rules and services. We link to official sources, explain what to check, and show when we last reviewed our guidance.

Official source ownerAustralian Government, state, and territory agencies publish the requirements and services relevant to each part of the move.
Open Path's roleWe write the plain-language orientation, order the questions, and share lived experience. We do not decide eligibility or provide migration advice.
What the date meansThe date below is when we opened the listed official pages and reviewed the related Open Path notes. It is not the date the government changed a rule.
Link checksWe automatically check many listed links weekly. Some sites block automated requests, so not every link can be reliably checked. A passing check does not verify changed content or guidance.

Check again before acting.

Official pages and local services can change between reviews. Automated checks can be blocked or inconclusive, and they do not detect rule or content changes. Check the relevant authority for current instructions and your circumstances. For individual visa help, confirm who is legally able to provide immigration assistance.
